2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner as well as learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the records.
3.

This is an application under Section 438, Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections 363,366,376(2)(n), 376(3), 109/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 17 of POCSO Act. in C.T.Special POCSO No.106 of 2022 arising out of Korei P.S.Case No.271 of 2024 of the Court of learned Ad hoc Additional District & Sessions Judge (FTSC-II), Jajpur.
4.

It is stated by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that the principal accused in the present case,
who had faced trial in the meantime has been acquitted.
So far the present Petitioner is concerned, it is stated that as per the F.I.R., the present Petitioner has assisted the principal accused.

5. Considering the submissions, the Petitioner, if so advised, may surrender before the learned Ad hoc Additional District & Sessions Judge (FTSC-II), Jajpur, in the aforesaid case within four weeks from today.

In the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail within the aforesaid period,
learned Ad hoc Additional District & Sessions Judge (FTSC- II), Jajpur shall do well to dispose of Akash Munda vs State Of Odisha .....
